(607)༄༅/khrus bgegs bskrad maṇḍal/nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du thugs bskyed de/gang gsan bya'i chos skabs su bab pa/snga 'ag

tei:div.tei:p: khrus bgegs bskrad maṇḍal/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du thugs bskyed de/ gang gsan bya'i chos skabs su bab pa/ snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa bka' gter gnyis las zab mo gter gyi ring lugs la phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i gter kha sogs mang du bzhugs pa'i nang tshan/ shud bu dpal gyi seng ge'i rnam 'phrul rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rjer rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor ma lus pas zhal gzigs te gdam ngag snyan brgyud du thob pa la gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha chen por grags pa'i nang nas= dbang bskur ba la gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dus gsum= oṃ ka ru= gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ tyaiḥ dad pa bskyed pa'i gzungs 'di'i rjes zlos/ ha ha= rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dkon mchog gsum la= de nas ye shes pa dbab pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob ma= lha bskyed 'don= de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum du// yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las// 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros// 'og min gnas nas ye shes pa/ kha char bu yug 'tshubs bzhin byon// slob ma nyid la sib (608)sib thim/ hūm̐: == lha tshogs ma lus rnams= sngags/ a be sha ya a/ brtan par gyur cig tiṣṭha badzra/ hūm̐: bum pa= hūm̐: gtor ma 'di ni= hū:ྃ == sku gzugs la= hū:ྃ ye shes = 'di'i rjes zlos/ ma hā gu ru= hūm̐: 'di ni rin chen= hūm̐: dus gsum= hūm̐/ slob ma= dbang 'grim/ bkra shis brjod/ des dbang legs par thob pa yin pas dam bsgrags pa ni/ sa ma ya ka hi ha sa ha/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams rim par bsrung dgos pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ka ti ka= gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ sa gzhi= dge rtsa gzhan don du bsngo bar zhu/ bsod nams = gzungs dbang blo la yod na/ mtshams sbyar 'di tsam byed nas/ gnam chos kyi dbang mi 'dra badrug babargya/ bskur lo/ dbang sgrub/ lha tsaka rgyab tu bri dgos//

(609)grub dbang padma nor bu'i bka' 'bum kha rtags can la/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i mkha' 'gro yang tig yid bzhin nor bu gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo btags tshul la ldeb/ nyer lnga la yum ka'i tshogs bskang 'don lugs ldeb/ nyer lnga'i tshogs bskang gi dung gling 'bud tshul la ldeb/ dung rgya 'bud tshig ldeb/ yum ka'i seng gdong 'don 'grigs ldeb/ bsam gtan 'od gsal gling gi lo bstar gyi dgu gtor bka' seng bsgrags ma'i lag len mthong gsal shel gyi me long ldeb/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed khro chu dug gdong gi bzlog pa spu gri reg gcod kyi 'don 'grigs mkhas grub karma chags med zhal lung ldeb/ tshe ring ma'i char 'bebs zur 'debs dge legs rgya mtsho'i sprin chen ldeb/ char gsol ldeb/ sprin mdo ldeb/ 'ja' tshon dkon mchog spyi 'dus sgrub chen 'don 'grigs ldeb/ zhi bsang 'don 'grigs ldeb/ yul lha'i bsang mchod ldeb/ bkra shis rol (610)tshigs ldeb/ smon tshig ldeb/ sman mchod ldeb/ tshogs kyi mchod pa la ldeb/ rdzong 'phrang las byang dngos grub rol pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba'i gsol 'debs ldeb/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad rdzong 'phrang srog gsum gyi las byang dngos grub rol pa'i dga' ston la ldeb/ dbang gi mtshams sbyor ldeb/ skyes rabs gsol 'debs ldeb/ rtag brtan smon tshig ldeb/ mnga' bdag nyang gi zab gter rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi las byang rgyun gyi nyams bzhes bya ba'i dmigs rim legs bshad skya rengs dang po la ldeb/ sgrub chen sa chog don bsdus me togs pa 'debs ldeb/ phywa g.yang sgrub pa'i phrin las khrigs su bkod pa bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po ldeb/ g.yang sgo 'byed pa'i cho ga rin po che lde mig ldeb/ gter srung nor lha rma chen spom ra'i gsol mchod bsam 'apel nor bu la ldeb/ cho ga'i sngon 'gro ldeb/

gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha dgongs gter them med dang bcas pa'i dbang gi 'grigs rim byin rlabs gter mdzod ldeb/ mchod (611) pa byin rlabs bya tshul ldeb/ gnam chos gzungs dbang 'grigs chags byin rlabs 'dod 'jo ldeb/ gnam chos dbang gi las slob kyi phyag bzhes bltas tshad kun grol ldeb/ gnam chos dbang bsdus pa bskur thabs ldeb/ yang thab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi tshe dbang gi mtshams sbyor bklag chog ldeb/ lhan thabs ldeb/ cho ga spyi'i bum sgrub ldeb/ khrus bgegs bskrad maṇḍal ldeb/ dkar chag ldeb/ bcas bsdoms ldeb grangs/ ༈ rgyal kun spyi gzugs mtsho skyes rje'i// ring lugs 'dzin la zla bral ba// thub bstan chos kyi glang po yi// phrin las sa gsum khyab gyur cig /dge'o// dge'o// dge'o//
